newsitem.title: USA: Cast of Les Miserables gets the boot.
newsitem.headline: Cast of Les Miserables gets the boot.

text.p: The cast of Les Miserables, the hit Broadway musical based on the Victor Hugo novel, has the blues.
The producers decided to dump the 37-member cast early next year so that they can restructure the show with a new production in time to celebrate its 10th anniversary on Broadway next March.

The show has been seen by more than 5.8 million people since it opened on Boradway in 1987 and by more than 40 million people in productions worldwide. The show's global box office receipts now exceed $1.6 billion, the producers said.
It is already the fourth longest running show in Broadway history.
Nine cast members were asked to stay on, nine to audition for new roles and 12 not to return. The five child actors in the show were not affected and two roles are currently open.
A spokesman for the producers said he believed it was the first time that the cast of a hit show would be so extensively revamped in favour of a new production.
